quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his increased aggression and drawing more fouls
quotes.excerpt: Just being aggressive overall in general. I have seen that I have gotten to the free-throw line.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jalen, first, it looks like there are some more attack opportunities, you get into the line a little bit more. Was that a point of emphasis for you to get more free-throw attempts?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: A little bit. Just being aggressive overall in general. I have seen that I have gotten to the free-throw line a little bit more early on.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green says his increased free-throw attempts early this season are a result of just being aggressive overall in general.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on adjusting to new offensive foul calls
quotes.excerpt: We are just learning about it right now. Obviously they are looking at a lot more.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Do you feel like there is even more on the table as far as you attacking more and drawing more of that contact? I know there was one time you did go in and they called a foul on you. How are you weighing that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: We are just learning about it right now. Obviously they are looking at a lot more this year with the push-off and how they are going to call it. Obviously it is early on, so the refs are learning as we are learning too. There is a way to get around that. Usually just get low, more shoulder than extension.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green on adjusting to the league's tighter whistle on offensive fouls: We are just learning about it right now. Usually just get low, more shoulder than extension.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his comfort level as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: I feel comfortable bringing the ball up, getting guys into sets. I am very comfortable having the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How did you feel in the playmaker mode? At least initiating offense, there were times obviously you think you found Luke for a three, but then starting the offense, where are you at with that right now as far as comfortable being comfortable?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I feel comfortable bringing the ball up, getting guys into sets. I am very comfortable having the ball in my hands in general. As far as making the right read, that is where my head is at right now, getting into the paint, draw two, make the right read on the outside.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green feels comfortable initiating the offense for the Suns: I am very comfortable having the ball in my hands in general. As far as making the right read, that is where my head is at right now.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on Devin Booker's ability to manipulate defenses
quotes.excerpt: Book is really good at his communication, communicating what he needs and in what positions.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When it comes to bringing the ball up, a lot of that I think is to get Book in those elbow spots that he likes so much. How is it to see him in those spots where it seems like he knows every counter for where defenses can play him?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: Book is really good at his communication, communicating what he needs and in what positions. It is all a flow of the game. Book is a big like flow and flow of the offense type of guy. He is going to make the right read regardless. If they do not have his side, we are just playing in like a circle, moving as one basically.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green on playing alongside Devin Booker: Book is really good at his communication. It is all a flow of the game. He is going to make the right read regardless.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on Devin Booker's movement off the ball
quotes.excerpt: You see Book play on the ball, you see Book play off the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: I don't know if it's come up with him before, but his idols, Rip Hamilton. Do you see that with like the way that he likes to move off the ball? It's a pretty underrated part of his game.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: You see Book play on the ball, you see Book play off the ball. He is one of the top shooting guards in the NBA for a reason. As coach says, his superpower, or whatever you want to call it, Book has multiple of those, so he can play on-ball, off-ball, and makes the game easier for us.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green praises Devin Booker's versatility: You see Book play on the ball, you see Book play off the ball. He is one of the top shooting guards in the NBA for a reason.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the starting unit's defensive chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I think first game was great against Detroit. I think we came out with a lot of energy.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How do you see the activity from the defense, especially with the starting unit, the way y'all are kind of meshing and finding some synergy with that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I think first game was great against Detroit. I think we came out with a lot of energy. I think second game we were a little slow defensively. Maybe it was the faster playing team with Chicago, but at the end of the day, the second unit came in and picked it up for us. I think we are pretty good, being on the string and locking in. We just got to bring that energy from the jump.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green on the Suns defensive consistency: We were a little slow defensively against Chicago. We just got to bring that energy from the jump.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the team's chemistry and potential
quotes.excerpt: We got a good, a good group of guys that is going to play hard.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How do you feel about the makeup of this team so far? Last year you came in, you were new, then you got hurt. What is your take?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I think we got a good, a good group of guys that is going to play hard and bring energy every night, from the first to the second string unit. Even the bench guys, every man on the roster is going to bring energy at the end of the night. So that is the biggest thing for us. We got a good camaraderie, togetherness. I think it is going to be a good year.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green likes the makeup of this year's Suns squad: We got a good group of guys that is going to play hard and bring energy every night. We got a good camaraderie, togetherness.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on his first time crossing paths with Devin Booker
quotes.excerpt: It is my sixth year in the NBA. I have been playing against Book for six years.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Do you recall the first time you kind of crossed paths with him?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: It is my sixth year in the NBA. I have been playing against Book for six years. I mean, I met his pops a while ago when I was like a younger. So I always knew of Book. My first like crossing paths was probably my rookie year.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green notes he has been playing against Devin Booker for six years, with their first crossing paths coming during his rookie season.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on Devin Booker's presence in Phoenix
quotes.excerpt: Book is like the head honcho of Arizona, you know what I am saying?

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When you came here, could you feel the presence in the city that he has? I mean, he grew up here, he came here when he was 19.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: Book is like the head honcho of Arizona, you know what I am saying? Getting drafted here and being here for 12 seasons, being here for 12 seasons is crazy. I mean, can't wish for nothing better in the NBA, especially with Arizona as their fans. Their fans really soak up and care about basketball. It is important for the players to feel that and I know Book feel loved here for sure.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green on Devin Booker's status in Phoenix: Book is like the head honcho of Arizona. Being here for 12 seasons is crazy. I know Book feel loved here for sure.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Green on the team's longevity and veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: It is amazing to be in one spot for your whole career.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Do you know who the oldest guy is on the team off the top of your head?

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: I am going to say it is either DB, H, or Book. How old do I? A lot of guys are born in '96. It is technically Dylan. Luke is born in '96, Duop is born in '96, and so is Devin too. It is not very usual anymore in the NBA, right? I mean, you have Steph Curry playing his whole career with the Warriors. There is not too many players that play their entire career with one team.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Yeah, it is not very usual anymore in the NBA, right? I mean, you have Steph Curry playing his whole career with the Warriors. There is not too many players that play their entire career with one team.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Green
text_blocks.text: That is amazing to be in one spot for your whole career. I know it is a good feeling for Book and I mean, it is the city of Arizona is a great city, so I would not be mad at that shit either.

quotes.social_post: Jalen Green reflects on the rarity of players spending their entire career with one team: There is not too many players that play their entire career with one team. That is amazing to be in one spot for your whole career.
